chapters.label: Live: the 2000 World Cup final
chapters.text: World Cup final, 2000. Brazil lead Spain three two, with five minutes left. Then Javi scores. Three all! And another! Four three to Spain!

chapters.label: World champions
chapters.text: The buzzer goes. Spain are world champions for the first time! Brazil had won the three World Cups before.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Javi was a sharp ala, a winger, brilliant one against one. Watch how he does it: he dribbles slowly, the defender relaxes, then boom! He explodes past him and shoots!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Your turn: go slow, then change speed suddenly, and lose your defender!
